title: The natural cochain section unit for a direct image
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes, with the fixed derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an integer q, define a natural transformation from H^q of the presheaf of sections of termwise f_* to localHypercohomologyPresheaf(S,q) after the standard Rf_* and Q. First use the inverse-open derived unit [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf], transported from homotopy classes to cochains and then to homology. Follow it by local Leray and the unique natural isomorphism from sectionDerivedDirectImage(f) to the standard derivedModuleDirectImage(f) that preserves the units. On each K-injective representative this isomorphism equals topEdgeDirectImageComparison [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. Evaluation at V is precomposed by the exact evaluation/homology comparison, giving directImageSectionUnitAt. The evaluated transformation is natural for every cochain map, without injectivity assumptions.

proof.text: Use the standard right-derived universal property and uniqueness for the arbitrary-quasi-isomorphism construction to choose the unique natural isomorphism preserving the two units. On a K-injective complex, expand both model comparisons as inverse units and use naturality to identify them. Transport along the fixed K-injective representative to identify its component with topEdgeDirectImageComparison.

Compose localHypercohomologyComparison with homology of the natural direct-image comparison. The stated hom equation of unboundedDirectImage_sectionPresheaf and the component equality just proved identify this natural transformation with the inverse of topEdgeLocalLeray.

Transport the inverse-open unit through quotientCompQhIso, apply derived homology, and precompose with the inverse homology factorization. Compose with the natural comparison of the preceding step. Exact evaluation supplies directImageSectionUnitAt. Its naturality is the composite of the naturality of this transformation and the exact evaluation/homology isomorphism. Expanding the model comparison at the identity of a K-injective gives the asserted model formula.

def directImageSectionUnit {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (q : ℤ) :
    (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        RingedSpace.localAbelianSections S.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) q ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙
        RingedSpace.localHypercohomologyPresheaf S.toRingedSpace q
